occurrences.checkable_against: Italian prosecutors' request for trial and Monza criminal case records
occurrences.quote_span: Italian prosecutors have requested that Luca Garavoglia, chairman of drinks group Campari (CPRI.MI), stand trial over alleged evasion of €1.29 billion ($1.45 billion) in taxes, two people with direct knowledge of the matter said.
occurrences.speaker: two people with direct knowledge of the matter
occurrences.subject: Luca Garavoglia and Giovanni Berto

occurrences.checkable_against: Prosecutors' case file and Guardia di Finanza investigative report
occurrences.quote_span: According to prosecutors and the Guardia di Finanza finance police, the operation was designed to avoid the so-called exit tax on the capital gains when the company moved its registered office outside Italy.
occurrences.speaker: Italian prosecutors and Guardia di Finanza finance police
occurrences.subject: Luca Garavoglia and Giovanni Berto

occurrences.checkable_against: Defense counsel appearances and Monza court case records
occurrences.quote_span: Iannaccone and fellow lawyer Nerio Diodà are representing the two defendants.

occurrences.subject: Luca Garavoglia and Giovanni Berto

occurrences.checkable_against: Monza court scheduling records and preliminary-hearing decision
occurrences.quote_span: A judge will now have to schedule a preliminary hearing, at the end of which a decision will be made on whether to send the defendants to trial or dismiss the case.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Luca Garavoglia and Giovanni Berto

occurrences.checkable_against: Alicros-Lagfin merger agreement and Italian/Luxembourg corporate registry records
occurrences.quote_span: The case stems from a 2018 merger between Alicros, the Italian company that controlled the Campari group, and Luxembourg-based Lagfin, which held a majority stake in Alicros.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Luca Garavoglia and Giovanni Berto

occurrences.checkable_against: Monza prosecutors' case file and Italian tax assessment records
occurrences.quote_span: Prosecutors allege they uncovered €5.3 billion in undeclared capital gains between 2018 and 2020 on which Lagfin failed to pay a €1.29 billion exit tax levied on companies that transfer their fiscal residence abroad.
occurrences.speaker: Italian prosecutors
occurrences.subject: Luca Garavoglia and Giovanni Berto

occurrences.checkable_against: Merger documents, Campari shareholder records and historical market capitalization data
occurrences.quote_span: The merger combined the two entities into a single company holding a 51% stake in Campari, then worth more than €4 billion on the stock market, and transferred the structure to Luxembourg.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Luca Garavoglia and Giovanni Berto

occurrences.checkable_against: Campari corporate governance records and shareholder disclosures
occurrences.quote_span: Garavoglia, 57, has been chairman of Campari since 1994 and is the largest shareholder in the group through the Lagfin vehicle.

occurrences.subject: Luca Garavoglia and Giovanni Berto

occurrences.checkable_against: Reuters interview with Giuseppe Iannaccone and court defense filings
